summary_1line: Narada guides Matali through the Naga underworld—Patala and Hiranyapura—describing cosmic wonders, imprisoned Asuras, sacred phenomena, and searching unsuccessfully for a worthy bridegroom.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the depths of Patala, the celestial elephant Airavata lifts cool water from the underworld seas to send it upward as rain for the world.
A mysterious radiant egg lies unmoving in dark waters of the underworld, said to unleash world‑ending fire at the end of time.
The golden and silver city of Hiranyapura gleams with gem-studded towers while fierce Danavas and Rakshasas dwell within its illusion-filled palaces.
